notes: Product pages are reachable and public, but each one shows only the current-year price, not a history. Products 328 (300 cycle, 10B NovaX, JAX-GM) and 358 (300 cycle, 25B NovaX, JAX-GM) each carry a single row dated 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31. Product 328 is $1,397.00 each and product 358 is $2,936.57 each. These are the JAX-GM variants, an external-account price tier. Products 657, 368 and 391 returned 404, so the IDs from the candidate list are stale or wrong. I did not find a NovaSeq 6000 S4 or AVITI product. The facility listing (/facilities/13) timed out on the one attempt. No 2024 or 2025 prices appear on the pages, so there is no time series and no change in price can be calculated. The page layout may hold only the active price row, so a year-over-year series would need Wayback snapshots, which the task excluded. The 25B price of $2,936.57 is about $2.94/Gb on 1,000 Gb. That matches the UConn $2.94 figure already known (F259), so it adds nothing.
how_to_mine: Retry https://honeycrisp.core.uconn.edu/facilities/13 to list the product IDs. Fetch each ID for S4, AVITI and the internal-rate variants. Then request Wayback snapshots of products 328 and 358 from 2024 and 2025 to get the per-year price change. Watch for end-of-year rate resets on 1 January.
